attributes.description: Low-top sneaker silhouette with a rounded toe box, padded tongue/collar, and thick flat rubber cupsole.
Light sky-blue glossy upper with smooth/patent-like finish.

Distinctive yellow elongated four-pointed emblem on the lateral side panel. It has a vertically elongated lower point extending downward toward the sole and a shorter horizontal point; its geometry is asymmetric and should not be replaced by a conventional five-point star.
Multiple small perforation holes arranged in rows across the toe box.
Small yellow tab/detail near the upper portion of the tongue.
Clearly visible ribbed/textured pattern along the blue sole sidewall.
